label: linux-corrected

environment.topology: One actual small trial per private prepared-snapshot clone, with the same recorded source/migration overlay. Cross-VM host/cache/I/O noise is explicit; no same-host causal speedup claim.

latency_definition: Stored committed_at is a transaction marker; measured terminal latency is first independently observed committed visibility minus ingested_at on the PostgreSQL server clock, including polling/query overhead.

postgresql.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Ubuntu 18.6-0ubuntu0.26.04.1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 15.2.0-16ubuntu1) 15.2.0, 64-bit

observer.read_scope: Privileged independent observer; adds measurement overhead to both worker configurations.

all latest versions payloads and authoritative sources
